audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Ziggs five of seven stages including Level 6 and both item stages, while the prose says the opposite at each of them: whys[2] 'genuinely contested', whys[4] Shen's R reframes the game, whys[5] Sunfire finally makes trades profitable, whys[6] 'depends on the team fight'.
audit.why: The matchup sits at 50.23% over 862 games — a coin flip, not a five-stage loss. The packet chart reads Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Shen / Shen / Skill, which matches the text exactly: he owns the first two levels on range alone, then it evens out and Shen's ultimate and first item take the middle.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Skill / Shen / Shen / Skill in BOTH layers, ratings moved with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text stated 'Ziggs' 24-second Satchel Charge cooldown'. Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12.
audit.why: The whole matchup is built on one number — the window after Satchel is spent is the only time Shadow Dash is safe. A four-second overestimate at rank 1 tells the player to walk in while the knockback is already back up, and mid already contradicts it with 'roughly 20 seconds'. Hexplosive Minefield is 16s at every rank, Bouncing Bomb 6s at rank 1, Mega Inferno Bomb 120s against your 200s Stand United.
audit.corrected: 20s at rank 1 in spikes[3].text, whys[1], dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns, with Hexplosive Minefield's flat 16s added as the second clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] said "Use W's Spirit Refuge" — the ability is Spirit's Refuge — and told the player to block 'empowered autos' without saying what makes them empowered or what W cannot stop.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks ATTACKS. Short Fuse (P) periodically empowers his next basic attack and its cooldown drops every time he casts a spell, so that one IS blockable — but Bouncing Bomb, Hexplosive Minefield and Mega Inferno Bomb are abilities and pass straight through the zone. Satchel Charge also knocks Ziggs himself away, which is how he leaves a landed taunt, and no amount of W stops that.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] rewritten to name Spirit's Refuge, target Short Fuse specifically, and state plainly that his bombs are not blocked; breakdown.cooldowns now says Satchel launches him out as well as you.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames ('Ziggs' Hexplosive Minefield', 'Drop Hexplosive Minefield') are FALSE POSITIVES — that is his real E. Left untouched.

edits.before: Ziggs' 24-second Satchel Charge cooldown is the only window Shen can dash in — the instant it lands, E-taunt and Q through the blade before Ziggs resets distance.
edits.after: Ziggs' 20-second Satchel Charge cooldown is the only window Shen can dash in — the instant it detonates, E-taunt and Q through the blade before he resets distance.

edits.before: Satchel Charge comes online at Level 2 and he can knock you back the instant you dash — only use Shadow Dash after you see it land on the ground.
edits.after: Satchel Charge (20s at rank 1) arrives at 2 and knocks you back the instant you dash — spend Shadow Dash only once you have watched it detonate.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1 — it knocks you back and launches him out of your taunt, so engage only once it is spent. - Hexplosive Minefield: 16s at every rank, the slow that keeps you out. - Shadow Dash: 18s. - Stand United: 200s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His knockback and self-peel escape, 20s at rank 1. Engage once you have seen it detonate.

edits.before: Use W's Spirit Refuge to block Ziggs' empowered autos if he ever steps into lane
edits.after: Use Spirit's Refuge on his Short Fuse auto — it eats attacks, never his bombs

notes: The kit file tags Satchel Charge with a 'percentHealth' flag and _missing/shen.json builds a 'resistances-invalidated' headline on it, but Riot's own description is flat magic damage plus a knockback with no percent-health component. I trusted the description and wrote NOTHING about armour or MR being the wrong answer here — the flag looks like a tooltip-parsing misfire and that headline should not be applied to this matchup. Also unverified and left alone: whether Satchel Charge's knockback can pull Ziggs out of an already-applied Shadow Dash taunt (displacement-vs-taunt priority is not in Riot's text), and whether tenacity or Mercury's Treads shorten the taunt-escape window — report[8] recommends Mercury's Treads here and I did not touch that.
